brief: Set on a pageload span. Describes how much of the document's HTML the server rendered before the request, to serve the same HTML to every visitor.
additional_context: Not set when the server rendered the whole document for this request, or when the SDK cannot tell.
Describes the server render only. A response that a CDN or the browser cache reused does not count. The browser's own prerendering (Speculation Rules) is described by `browser.navigation.type`.

enum_values.brief: The server rendered the whole document before the request, for example at build time or during an earlier request (Next.js ISR, Nuxt `swr` route rules).
The server rendered a static part of the document before the request, and the other parts for this request in the same response (Next.js Partial Prerendering).
